options.name: account_block_period
options.description: Account Block Period. Only available when 'account_lockout' is enabled.

options.name: account_lockout
options.description: Enable or disable Account Lockout.

options.name: alert-type
options.description: Select Alert Type.

options.name: auth_delegation
options.description: Authentication Delegation.

options.name: auth_server-pool
options.description: Authentication Server Pool. Only available when 'client_auth_method' is 'html-form-auth'.

options.name: block_period
options.description: Block Period. Only available when 'security_action' is 'block-period'.

options.name: client_auth_method
options.description: Client Authentication Method. Only available when 'cookieless' is enabled.

options.name: cookie_timeout
options.description: Authentication Cookie Timeout.

options.name: cookieless
options.description: Enable or disable cookieless.

options.name: credential_stuffing_online_query
options.description: Enable or disable Credential Stuffing Defense.

options.name: credential_stuffing_protection
options.description: Enable or disable Credential Stuffing Online Check.

options.name: form_based_delegation
options.description: Form based delegation. Only available when 'client_auth_method' is 'html-form-auth' and 'auth_delegation' is 'form-based-delegation'.

options.name: limit_users
options.description: Enable or disable Limit Concurrent Users Per Account.

options.name: match_type
options.description: Select Match type.

options.name: max_login_failures
options.description: Max Login Failures. Only available when 'account_lockout' is enabled.

options.name: maximum_users
options.description: Maximum Concurrent Users. Only available when 'limit_users' is enabled.

options.name: name
options.description: A unique name that can be referenced in other parts of the configuration.

options.name: ntlm-server
options.description: NTLM Server. Only available when 'client_auth_method' is 'ntlm-auth'.

options.name: path
options.description: Path of Published Site.

options.name: published_site
options.description: Name of Published Site.

options.name: published_site_type
options.description: Published Site Type. Simple string ('plain') or regular expression ('regular').

options.name: redirect_url
options.description: Redirect URL After Authentication (Optional).

options.name: security
options.description: Select security level.

options.name: security_action
options.description: Choose the action FortiWeb takes when a rule is violated.

options.name: session_idle_timeout
options.description: Session Idle Timeout (Unit: minute). Only available when 'limit_users' is enabled.

options.name: sso_domain
options.description: SSO Domain. Only available when 'sso_support' is enabled.

options.name: sso_support
options.description: SSO Support.

options.name: trigger
options.description: Select the trigger policy, if any, that FortiWeb carries out when it logs and/or sends an alert email about a violation.

options.name: within
options.description: The number of minutes allowing max login login failures. Only available when 'account_lockout' is enabled.
